total_earthquakes <- nrow(clean)

The total number of earthquakes in the last 30 days was 506

daily_summary <- clean |>
  group_by(date = as.Date(time)) |>
  summarise(
    count = n()
  )

print(daily_summary)

ggplot(daily_summary, aes(x = date, y = count)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(title = "Earthquake Count by Day", x = "Date", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
